xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5638: Polyrepo review verdicts and the merge train ignore GitHub member PRs

plan.title: Polyrepo review verdicts and the merge train ignore GitHub member PRs
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-5641 (sibling: polyrepo promote eligibility and board)

narratives.Problem: A polyrepo issue that changes a GitHub member repo cannot record its review verdict or enter the ready set. postPolyrepoReviewVerdict (src/cli/commands/specialists/done.ts) refuses when any member artifact is on GitHub. githubRows (src/lib/overdeck/ready-set.ts) judges a GitHub member row only by the listing's reviewDecision, which GitHub leaves empty on unprotected branches; the MYN member PRs are self-authored, so the verdict lands as an overdeck-verdict marker comment the ready set never reads. A blocked verdict on a GitHub-only polyrepo issue also never reaches the work agent, because getPrFacts cannot see GitHub members of a Linear/GitLab project.
narratives.Proposal: Add one trusted reader, readGitHubMemberPrFacts (new src/lib/cloister/github-member-pr-facts.ts), that reads a GitHub PR by URL and builds PrFacts through a newly exported pr-facts gitHubPrFacts, so marker trust rules apply. readMemberMrFacts dispatches GitHub URLs to it. The polyrepo verdict write drops its GitHub refusal and posts on every member; rejection visibility re-reads every member. The ready set reads an undecided, green, mergeable GitHub member row's own facts (dated trusted marker, or a standing review at head via readGitHubMemberReadyFacts), cached per PR head for 60 s, throwing ReadySetUnavailableError on a failed read. Docs and changelog follow. PRD: .pan/drafts/PAN-5638.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Polyrepo UAT promote eligibility (getDerivedIssueState reads the non-git project root) and the merge-train board's polyrepo cars; tracked in PAN-5641
- Any change to the GitHub monorepo ready-set loop in listReadyIssuesForProject or the single-repo merge gate's sha-proven approval rule
- Making getPrFacts(issueId) polyrepo-aware
- Changing the verdict guard's getPrFacts read for agent callers (reviewVerdictRefusal input)
- Parsing verdict markers anywhere outside pr-facts' trust rules
- Per-member reviewed heads or a sha= on polyrepo markers
- Installing the GitHub App on mindyournow or adding branch protection
- Raising any file-size allowlist cap
- Test and UAT verdicts (pan admin specialists done test|uat) keep commenting on the first member artifact only

autoDecisions.summary: The ready set counts a GitHub member PR approved by pr-facts' dated rule (facts.approved: forge decision, or newest trusted marker no older than the head commit), plus a trusted standing review at head; it does not require a sha= marker.
autoDecisions.rationale: Polyrepo review run ids hash a composite anchor (review-agent.ts line 471), so reviewedHeadSha never matches a member head and every polyrepo marker is posted without sha=. A sha-required rule could never be met. The GitLab member rule (facts.approved) is not head-pinned either.

autoDecisions.summary: Use pr-facts' trusted reader instead of the issue's suggestion to call parseVerdictMarkerWithSha directly in githubRows.
autoDecisions.rationale: All three MYN member repos are public; a bare marker parse would let any commenter approve a PR. gitHubPrFacts applies the author-association and App-bot rules.

autoDecisions.summary: Include rejection-visibility for polyrepo verdicts (WI-4), which the issue did not list.
autoDecisions.rationale: Without it, a blocked review of a GitHub-only polyrepo issue posts the marker but never drives the work agent, because getPrFacts cannot see GitHub members of a Linear-tracked project. Recording the verdict without delivering it is a partial feature.

autoDecisions.summary: Promote eligibility and the merge-train board stay out of scope; filed as PAN-5641.
autoDecisions.rationale: Both read one PR from the non-git polyrepo root and break every polyrepo issue, not just GitHub members. No MYN batch has been created since 2026-08-14, so that path is unexercised and deserves its own plan.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the readMemberMrFacts name and add GitHub dispatch rather than renaming.
autoDecisions.rationale: Three test files mock that export; a rename adds churn with no behavior change. The doc comment states it reads a PR or an MR.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the new reader in a new module and change pr-facts.ts by one extracted export only.
autoDecisions.rationale: pr-facts.ts is 996 lines against the 1000-line ceiling; the extraction nets +2 lines.

items.title: Add readGitHubMemberPrFacts: one GitHub member PR's facts by URL under the marker trust rules

expected_outputs: lint-file-size.sh exits 0 and wc -l src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts prints at most 1000

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. (1) In src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts extract the GitHub branch of readPrFacts (search 'const pr = await withCommentAuthorKinds(gh.pr, deps);') into an exported async function gitHubPrFacts(issueId, view: IssuePullRequestData, deps: PrFactsDeps = {}) placed directly above readPrFacts, and make readPrFacts call it ('if (gh.pr) return gitHubPrFacts(issueId, gh.pr, deps);'). Change nothing else in pr-facts.ts (net +2 lines; must stay <= 1000). (2) In src/lib/overdeck/pull-requests.ts export fetchPullRequestByNumber(issueId, repoArg, prNumber) that delegates to fetchIssuePullRequestFromRef and never caches. (3) Create src/lib/cloister/github-member-pr-facts.ts exporting readGitHubMemberPrFacts(issueId, url, deps) (parse owner/repo/number from the URL, fetch, return gitHubPrFacts; an unparseable URL, a null pr or a thrown fetch returns emptyPrFacts(issueId, reason) with error set; never throws) and readGitHubMemberReadyFacts(issueId, url, deps) (same facts, and when there is no error, no approval, no changes requested, open and not a draft, folds deps.standingApproval ?? forgeApprovalAtHead returning true into approved: true). Deps type GitHubMemberPrFactsDeps extends PrFactsDeps with fetchPr and standingApproval. (4) Write the tests listed in PRD WI-1 with every forge read injected.
